summary: Tested all new ImportReview features: CleanupModal, diff visualization, reconciliation badge, PDF endpoint structure, CSV upload, AI Categorize regression. Found and fixed a critical bug where CleanupModal 'Apply to all rows' was closing the parent ImportReview Dialog due to Radix onPointerDownOutside event. All 8 backend tests pass. Core UI features verified and working after fix.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED: Clicking 'Apply to all rows' in CleanupModal was closing the ImportReview Dialog. Root cause: CleanupModal renders as a fixed overlay (z-60) outside the Radix <Dialog>, but inside the React fragment. The Radix DismissableLayer fires onPointerDownOutside when any click is registered outside the DialogContent DOM subtree (even from a higher z-index fixed element). Fix: Added onPointerDownOutside={(e) => { if (showCleanup) e.preventDefault(); }} to DialogContent.

MINOR: Playwright's non-force click on cleanup-apply-btn reports 'DialogOverlay intercepts pointer events'. Button works via JS click and force=True. Potential real-user concern: verify Apply button is clickable by actual users in Chrome/Firefox (z-[60] should override z-50 DialogOverlay but stacking context may differ). Recommend E1 to verify manually or consider rendering CleanupModal via ReactDOM.createPortal to document.body.

rca_of_issue: Bug: After opening CleanupModal (fixed overlay z-[60]) and clicking 'Apply to all rows', the parent ImportReview Radix Dialog was also closing. RCA: Radix UI's DismissableLayer listens for pointerdown events and calls onPointerDownOutside if the event target is outside the DialogContent's DOM node. The CleanupModal's fixed overlay renders outside (as a sibling to) the Dialog in the DOM, so any pointerdown within the CleanupModal area is treated as 'outside' the Dialog, triggering onOpenChange(false) → handleClose(). Fix: Added onPointerDownOutside={(e) => { if (showCleanup) e.preventDefault(); }} to <DialogContent> to suppress this behavior when the cleanup modal is showing.
